title: When mercy feels hard to receive as a steady practice
issueStatement: The heart keeps assuming kindness must first be earned. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru keeps mercy close to gift, nearness, and return. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam. Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review.
actionPrompt: Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review. Repeat what you can actually keep.
